WITH relevant_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
)
SELECT count(*)
FROM (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM (
        SELECT c.c_last_name AS c_last_name,
               c.c_first_name AS c_first_name,
               rd.d_date AS d_date,
               1 AS channel
        FROM store_sales ss
        JOIN relevant_dates rd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = rd.d_date_sk
        JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        UNION ALL
        SELECT c.c_last_name AS c_last_name,
               c.c_first_name AS c_first_name,
               rd.d_date AS d_date,
               2 AS channel
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        JOIN relevant_dates rd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = rd.d_date_sk
        JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        UNION ALL
        SELECT c.c_last_name AS c_last_name,
               c.c_first_name AS c_first_name,
               rd.d_date AS d_date,
               3 AS channel
        FROM web_sales ws
        JOIN relevant_dates rd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = rd.d_date_sk
        JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    ) all_channels
    GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    HAVING bool_or(channel = 1) AND bool_or(channel = 2) AND bool_or(channel = 3)
) hot_cust
LIMIT 100
